title: Add "lbry" scheme to allowlist

labels.name: needs implementer interest
labels.description: Moving the issue forward requires implementers to express interest

body:
- [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed):
   * Blink (Chromium): `We will add support for this if it gets merged to the HTML spec`
   * Gecko (Firefox): The bug report did get reopened after I referenced to this pull request, so I assume they will implement it as soon as it is spec.
   * WebKit (Safari): WebKit is unable to implement `lbry`, because they don't support `registerProtocolHandler` at all. However, they didn't oppose.
- [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at:
   * N/A
- [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed:
   * Blink (Chromium): https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=1514394
   * Gecko (Firefox): https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1871955
   * WebKit (Safari): https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=266903 and https://feedbackassistant.apple.com/feedback/13571353
- [x] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: https://github.com/mdn/mdn/issues/472

(See [WHATWG Working Mode: Changes](https://whatwg.org/working-mode#changes) for more details.)
